episodes.title: The Philosophy and Politics of the Hallowed Weenie in Disguise and, Eventually, Death feat. Robert Lucas
episodes.description:
Well, well, well, here we are again, back at the description of a strangely named podcast episode. That's okay, we're glad you're here! 

The Yellow Notebook Podcast wishes you a happy late Halloween and election season. However, if you're missing costumes and ballots, we have you covered. This episode covers ideas in these genres and more!

Robert Lucas rejoins the crew to share his ideas with us and maybe even a recipe you'll need to try. Thanks for listening!

episodes.title: From the Vault - Again
episodes.description: We liked it so much last time, we did it again. Previously unaired ideas from historical episodes. Irregular programming, but sill a good time. Enjoy!

episodes.title: The Most Financially Lucrative Episode feat. Addison Bankhead
episodes.description:
Want to make some good money? Listen to this episode. It is so full of good ideas that can turn a profit, people will be begging to put their money in your pockets. This is not a promise.

Addison Bankhead makes a wonderful addition to this episode as he joins the crew in their discussing bathroom and kitchen ideas, puppy subscriptions, laundromats, the national anthem, and more! And back by popular demand, or at least because no one asked us not to, Round Robin Rapid Fire! 

So much good packed into one tiny podcast episode, you won't want to miss it. Thanks for listening.

episodes.title: The Isaac, Andrew, Tim Show
episodes.description: Special episode alert! Things are a little different on this episode where our hosts each takeover a segment of the show. Don't worry, though, ideas still abound! Updates and two Community Spotlights to boot, this is episode simply can't be missed! Thanks for listening in.

episodes.title: From the Vault
episodes.description: Take a look in the past as we explore previously unaired ideas from historical episodes. Relive the bygone days a little and catch a little behind the scenes magic. We have a good time!

episodes.title: Losing Touch feat. Ben Hamre
episodes.description:
Are we losing touch? Well, yes, actually. Find out about it here in another exciting installment of the Yellow Notebook Podcast. Thrills! Chills! Mills! But mostly ideas.

Hear from fan favorite Ben "the Flying Hammer" Hamre as he joins the crew to lend more of his thought-provoking ideas and his deep, buttery voice. Here you'll find ideas about quality and convenience, malls, USB, human fragility, and more. Don't miss the new, classic Round Robin Rapid-Fire corner. Even a Patreon update that is so unreal, it's hard to believe (it may or may not be that there was a misunderstanding, that's okay). So much good stuff, thanks for listening!

episodes.title: Identity Theft feat. Big Dog
episodes.description:
Something fishy might be happening here. Don't let that deter you. Just come on in and join the usual crew of Tim, Isaac and Andrew as they along with distinguished guest Big Dog extract some of the best ideas this side of embarassment.

Ponder ideas about hamsters, NPCs, billboards, even embarassment, and more! And a new segment, Rapid-Fire Round Robin! So much good stuff here, thanks for listening!

episodes.title: Ideas from Ecuador feat. Blake Bowen
episodes.description:
Gracias por escuchar el Podcast del Cuaderno Amarillo. Esta semana tenemos una invitado muy especial: Blake de Ecuador.

Blake traveled from distant lands just to spend time sharing his ideas with the Yellow Notebook Podcast. Well, he most likely had other reasons to be around but we like to think otherwise.

Listen in for more ideas that are sure to become classics: slow-close car doors, driver's ed refresher courses, marketing healthy foods, hot spot maps, and more!

episodes.title: The End of Thousands feat. Michael Pederson
episodes.description:
Welcome to the Yellow Notebook Podcast. Again.  Thanks to Michael Pederson for joining us to explore some more ideas.

Are sports boring? Listen up. Want to be a millionaire? Listen up. Don't want people to steal your things? Listen up. And more! So many reasons to give this episode a listen.

episodes.title: A Poetry of Ideas and Other Arts and Scams feat. Carson Haskell
episodes.description:
Will the ideas ever stop? No way, they just keep on coming. Special guest Carson Haskell brings a fistful of new ideas to the show and they are great!

Tune in for some strong opinions, great ideas, hot takes, and some general inquisitiveness. The idea crew what they do best (on the podcast, arguably). But where is Tim?

episodes.title: Corners
episodes.description:
What are all the corners again? Don't worry, we have you covered.

Join the Yellow Notebook crew for a brand new show all about ideas, new and old. No guest? No problem! Get some behind-the-scenes peaks at what's really going on around here.

And, of course, more ideas.

episodes.title: Girl, I Found This Cute Little Episode feat. Mary Dimond
episodes.description:
Are you still wondering what an idea is? What is the real definition? Is it possible that we finally define this elusive concept?

Well, no. But Mary Dimond joins the podcast on this episode and challenges where some of the boundaries of ideas are. What a great idea!

Listen in as we discuss this and many more new, sparkly ideas.

episodes.title: So I Heard You Were Talking About A Eye feat. Nathan Cruz - pt 2
episodes.description:
Part 2 of the continuing saga of our first ever guest and first ever returning guest Nate Cruz. If you missed Part 1, go back and listen to it now, it is crucial. More or less. Probably less.

Okay, more ideas. More drama. More cheers. More heartbreak. More AI. Here we go.

episodes.title: So I Heard You Were Talking About A Eye feat. Nathan Cruz - pt 1
episodes.description:
Our first ever guest Nate Cruz returns to give the Yellow Notebook Podcast some ideas to chew on. Don't miss this beautiful redemption story.

Here we have more great ideas from great people, but you'll have to listen to find out. Here's a hint: AI. Let's discuss.

Stay tuned for Part 2.

episodes.title: Ideas from Michigan feat. Nicolas Heady
episodes.description:
Is the Yellow Notebook Podcast going live from Michigan? Well, no. Even, better. We brought in one of the state's best podcast guests to import some great ideas from the great Wolverine State.

Nicolas Heady joins the crew to spout off a few ideas from a far-off land. Do you send greeting cards? What is a smart phone? Do you journal? Ah, you're intrigued already.

Also included are ideas about airplane seats, daily texts, family mottos, neighborhood cookouts, and more! And please watch out for fraudulent stamps.

episodes.title: Acquiring Your Taste feat. Ben Hamre
episodes.description:
How did you acquire your taste for the finer things in life? Hmmm...you are curious to know, I'm sure. What else?

Ever heard of Google? We have a lot of ideas about that here in this episode! But wait, there's more! More what, you ask? Ideas, of course.

Ben Hamre joins the crew as Temporary Interim Chief Idea Officer (TICIO) and brings a wealth of good ideas to the table. Listen in for those Google ideas, acquired tastes, clocks, medium talk, and more. Enjoy!

episodes.title: Gold Noodle Stars feat. Jeff Kapic
episodes.description:
Another treasure trove of ideas from the Yellow Notebook Podcast, quality unverified. 

Join the crew as we host guest Jeff Kapic, a man with some serious idea capability. What happens when you give Jeff a mic? Tech-forward creativity.

Listen in for ideas on Wifi device locators, Daylight Savings Time, Home Depot, dumbwaiter laundry chutes, and more!

episodes.title: You Probably Don't Like Your Job feat. Luke
episodes.description:
Well, do you? This episode might have all the answers you've been looking. Or it might just be chock full of ideas both great and strange.

Join the Yellow Notebook Podcast crew and special guest Luke as we dig into emails, work, bidets, Sasquatch boots and more. 

Recorded live in the new studio. Everything is different. Everything!

episodes.title: Creativity for Sale feat. Ray Nickel - pt. 2
episodes.description:
Part two of the Yellow Notebook Podcast's first double feature, this episode is an exciting ride up and down the seriousness curve.

Joining us this week is Ray Nickel who brings a wealth of wisdom to ponder about creativity and helping others.

Other ideas include shame, avocados, googling, elevators, social media, and more!

episodes.title: Creativity for Sale feat. Ray Nickel - pt. 1
episodes.description:
Part one of the Yellow Notebook Podcast's first double feature, this episode is an exciting ride up and down the seriousness curve.

Joining us this week is Ray Nickel who brings a wealth of wisdom to ponder about creativity and helping others.

Other ideas include shame, avocados, googling, elevators, social media, and more!

episodes.title: The True Potato Party feat. Gabby Goodsell
episodes.description:
Listen in as we finally learn what happened at the Community Spotlight-featured potato party from Episode 1.

Gabby Goodsell joins us to give us an explanation of the motivation behind the famous party and to give some more great ideas.

Be inspired by exploring with us lots of ideas on food, cars, tongue twisters, and more!

episodes.title: You are Probably Wrong feat. Zach Goodsell
episodes.description:
Happy Arbor Day, from our family to yours! Enjoy this gift of ideas from the Yellow Notebook Club, joined by special guest, Zach Goodsell.

What crazy concoctions are the crew cooking up today? No really, lots of food ideas. And is Isaac really changing his mind about AI?

Plays, movies, books, blood, hidden treasure, good ol' reliable Costco, and more. Listen up, and save the ideas!

episodes.title: Farren Glanson feat. Matt Voss
episodes.description:
Fast food? New album from a new artist? Anonymous listener? Get rid of math? The podcast is getting serious? Bathroom stalls? What do all these buttons do? Mysteries abound in this episode of the Yellow Notebook Podcast.

Celebrity guest Matt Voss joins the crew to help solve these and explore more ideas. More of what you have come to love or despise from the Yellow Notebook Club: more parking lots, more food, more AI, a gracious guest, ideas, Kidz Korner, and Community Spotlight. What else could you ask for?

Keep an ear out for music from Matt Voss.

episodes.title: Lots of Buggies feat. Robert Lucas
episodes.description:
What is a buggy? Robert Lucas knows. He's our special guest this week and he has a few ideas about them.

Join him and the Yellow Notebook Podcast as we all discuss and discover more ideas on things like buggies and their counterparts - parking lots, pens, quality tools, kindness, and Crocs (say it ain't so!). And more, of course.

Also, take a first listen to the statistics of the Yellow Notebook Podcast, being shared with transparency and some confusion.

Remember, ideas are everywhere. Don't forget to write them down or you might forget. Save the ideas!

episodes.title: Social Media, AI, and the Al-Gore-Rhythm feat. David Swindler
episodes.description:
The Yellow Notebook Podcast crew is lucky to be joined by special guest David Swindler, upping the audio quality of the episode just by bringing his legendary baritone radio voice. 

Listen in as we discuss more ideas including, but not limited to, Dungeons and Dragons, lethal babysitters, online payments and giving up. Stay until the end for a thought provoking discussion by the crew on social media, the Algorithm, and AI.

Rounding out this episode are fan-favorites (unverified) Kidz Korner and Community Spotlight.

episodes.title: Let's Get Political feat. Nathan Cruz
episodes.description:
A historic first! The Yellow Notebook podcast hosts their very first guest. Nate Cruz joins the fray as ideas are, as usual, brought to the forum, weighed and heavily scrutinized for the benefit of all.

This episode includes another historic first, Kidz Korner, an idea from a previous episode, showing that ideas are indeed powerful.

Also included are ideas spanning from miniature boat racing infrastructure, vigilante hackers, Gen Z slang, and politics. And more, how exciting!

episodes.title: Tim's Printer History
episodes.description:
Do you lie? Do you have a secret talent? Do you live somewhere? Do you like sandwiches? And what is this mystery that is Tim's printer history?

If you answered yes or no or "I don't know" to any of these questions, then this episode has something to say about that. And more! Ideas galore! 

If you like nice short episodes that are efficient and to the point, please turn this off before you start it. Otherwise, enjoy the ride through the river of genius in the making. Possibly the number one second episode ever in the world by the Yellow Notebook Club.

episodes.title: The Opinion Curve
episodes.description:
Discover the Opinion Curve that will change the way you argue. And the way you see all of life.

Find here the first ideas ever made (by us): a ridiculous review, opinions on sporks and stock photos, which type of milk you should choose, and more.

The debut podcast episode of the Yellow Notebook Club movement.
